title: Restructuring Global Supply Chains: Navigating Challenges of the COVID-19 Pandemic and Beyond
authors: Niu, Werle, Cohen, Cui, Deshpande, Ernst, Huchzermeier, Tsay, Wu
abstract: Examines how firms restructured global supply chains during and after COVID-19, analyzing resilience strategies, regionalization trends, and the trade-offs between efficiency and robustness.
